displayName: Write and save a cold email campaign from your lead list
summary: Turn a lead list into personalised draft emails ready to send.

useCases.title: Write and save a cold email campaign from your lead list
useCases.message: Help me run an email campaign. You might want to pull my lead list from Google Sheets. Then research each company, write a personalised email for each contact, and save them as drafts in my email inbox ready for me to review and send.
